tools.name: o_analyze_intent
tools.description: Analyze a .O program without executing it and issue a bounded, expiring, one-use same-intent handle (not authorization or a capability)

cwd.description: Optional working directory (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

path.description: Path to a .O program (absolute paths default cwd to their parent; relative paths use cwd/O_LANG_ROOT)

ttl_secs.description: One-use handle lifetime in seconds (default 120; maximum 900)

tools.name: o_capabilities
tools.description: Discover every Ostadix command family, resolved executables, help invocations, and task guides. Filter with query to keep context compact.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive capability, command, or family search.

tools.name: o_cli
tools.description: Run any cataloged Ostadix CLI with full literal argv, cwd, per-child env, stdin, optional PTY, and background jobs. Includes compiler/linker, projects, node/session/registry, O-core, live, capacity, and device operations. The selected CLI retains its own admission rules; this is direct execution and may mutate local or remote state.

args.description: Literal argument array. All CLI options/subcommands are available; no shell expansion is performed.

background.description: Return a job_id immediately. Use status/read/write/cancel across calls in this MCP session.

command.description: Exact Ostadix command ID from o_capabilities, such as O, o, olangc, o-link, octl, or ocorec.

cwd.description: Working directory; relative paths resolve against O_LANG_ROOT.

env.description: Per-child environment overrides; never changes another job or the MCP process environment.

pty.description: Allocate a Unix terminal for REPLs and terminal programs. Terminal output is merged in stdout.

stdin.description: Initial stdin text. Foreground pipe jobs receive EOF after this text; background jobs keep input open.

timeout_secs.description: Foreground default 120 seconds, background default no deadline. Zero explicitly disables the deadline.

tools.name: o_doctor
tools.description: Toolchain doctor with exact runtime provenance and client configuration file hashes. Default inventory only; execution_check explicitly runs a fixed Python 1+1 program with a 1..10 second deadline and bounded output. It does not qualify every runtime or native execution.

execution_check.description: Explicitly run only the fixed Python 1 + 1 smoke. Default false: inventory only.

timeout_secs.description: Fixed smoke deadline in seconds (1..10); default 5. No arbitrary source or command is accepted.

tools.name: o_env
tools.description: Report exact running MCP binary hash/architecture, compiled source identity, independently observed source root/commit/dirty state, selected tools/backends, client configuration file hashes and all-runtime inventory. Read-only; no execution health claim. Returns legacy text plus structured runtime provenance.

tools.name: o_eval
tools.description: Execute inline polyglot O source via O --eval without a temporary source file. Supports interpreter options, cwd, per-call env, stdin, PTY, and background jobs; hosted code has the same capabilities as normal O execution.

args.description: Interpreter options, such as --json, --executor graph, --workers, or backend grants.

source.description: Complete inline O source, including nested hosted languages. Passed literally to O --eval.

tools.name: o_execute
tools.description: Primary Ostadix computation interface. Supply exactly one complete O source or existing program/project path. Execute by default, or check syntax, plan, or compile an artifact. Preserves native runtime admission, project placement, structured results and job evidence; route selects project work and node sends a complete ordinary document to one authenticated peer. mode admitted binds local ordinary O source and intent before fresh admission. Expert CLI tools remain available.

action.description: execute (default), check (parse only), plan (non-executing schedule), or compile.

background.description: Return the managed execution job immediately after any required analysis.

env.description: Per-child environment overrides, isolated from other calls.

mode.description:
admitted executes through native fresh admission. Ordinary source also
binds an internally analyzed source/intent digest; no client handle is needed.

node.description:
Send an ordinary complete document to this native node. This is not
graph partitioning. env/cwd configure the local client, not the remote
workspace. Cancelling the client cannot cancel remote effects.

output.description:
Required destination for binary/wasm compilation, relative to cwd.
ir/dot return their text in result and do not accept output.

path.description:
Existing .O file or project directory. Absolute paths default cwd to
the file's parent or the project directory; relative paths use cwd/root.

placement.description:
auto uses the local O runtime for ordinary source and native mesh-prefer
placement for projects. mesh-required is supported only for project execution.

route.description:
Explicit project route or route-set for execute, plan, or IR/DOT output.
Marked operation projects retain their native planner's route selection.

source.description: Complete O source. Supply exactly one of source or path.

stdin.description: Initial stdin. Foreground sends EOF; background keeps the pipe open.

target.description:
For compile: ir, dot, binary (default), or wasm. script is an execution
target and belongs to action execute or the expert o_cli interface.

timeout_secs.description:
Overall operation budget in seconds. Foreground default 120; background
default unlimited. Zero disables the local deadline. Selected-node
execution also retains native IO/publication deadlines (see its result).

workers.description: Positive ordinary-O graph worker capacity; also supported for ordinary plans.

tools.name: o_execute_intent
tools.description: Consume a one-use o_analyze_intent handle and ask O to recompute the same stable Intent V1 before fresh V6 admission and dispatch

cwd.description: Working directory resolving to the same canonical cwd analyzed earlier

handle.description: Opaque one-use handle returned by o_analyze_intent

path.description: Path resolving to the same canonical .O program analyzed earlier

tools.name: o_guide
tools.description: Read shared human and LLM workflows for operations, runtime, compiler, projects, mesh, core, live, capacity, device, or agents. Defaults to topic all; the human CLI exposes the same content with o guide.

topic.description: Workflow topic: all, operations, runtime, compiler, projects, mesh, core, live, capacity, device, agents.

tools.name: o_information_inspect
tools.description: Inspect exactly one existing local Information V1 head through the fixed read-only o-info path; no cloud, network, mutation, dispatch, or arbitrary subcommands

head.description: Fixed local head name (default main; maximum 128 ASCII token bytes)

state.description: Existing local Information V1 state directory (absolute or relative to O_LANG_ROOT; maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes)

tools.name: o_job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one managed job and wait for its owned process cleanup. Other jobs continue independently.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by this MCP session. Jobs do not survive server shutdown.

tools.name: o_job_list
tools.description: List managed jobs in this MCP server session, including completion and exit status. Does not wait for running work.

tools.name: o_job_read
tools.description: Read a bounded stdout or stderr page using byte cursors. Complete output remains in disk logs; reading does not block or stop execution.

encoding.description: utf8_lossy (default) for text previews, or base64 for lossless binary/UTF-8 byte retrieval.

limit.description: Maximum bytes in this page, default 65536, maximum 262144. Full logs remain on disk.

offset.description: Byte cursor from a previous read; default zero.

stream.description: stdout (default) or stderr; PTY output is merged in stdout.

tools.name: o_job_status
tools.description: Inspect a managed job's state, exit code, log paths, and cleanup evidence. A started job is not a successful result.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by this MCP session. Jobs do not survive server shutdown.

tools.name: o_job_write
tools.description: Send literal input or EOF to a running managed job, including REPLs and PTY terminal programs. Input can cause the selected program to perform actions.

close.description: Close pipe stdin after writing; on a canonical PTY send terminal EOF.

input.description: Literal stdin text, including newlines or terminal control characters when needed.

timeout_secs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for input acceptance, including any earlier write; default 30. Zero disables the deadline.

tools.name: o_olangc
tools.description: Run olangc on a .O file, or materialize an exact binary/WASM Cargo project without invoking Cargo

materialize_only.description: Materialize the exact binary/WASM Cargo project into a new directory beneath the MCP server cwd without invoking Cargo

output.description: Optional -o output path (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

path.description: Path to a .O program (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

target.description: olangc target: ir | dot | script | wasm | binary. Omitted target defaults to binary and builds an executable; script executes the program. Use ir or dot for non-executing analysis.

tools.name: o_operation
tools.description: Manage a declared operation through the same native planner, executor and retained records as the human o CLI. Describe by default; list realizations, plan or explain compatibility and selection, explicitly run, observe an exact retained run, or replan with caller-supplied target exclusions. Replanning does not dispatch. Returns the unchanged native JSON report plus job evidence. Use o_guide topic operations for the full workflow and o_cli for expert record inspection/verification.

action.description:
describe (default), realizations, plan, explain (plan with causal
reasons), run (the only action that dispatches), observe, or replan.

background.description:
Return a managed job immediately. Use o_job_status/read to inspect its
result. Full native JSON and stderr remain in the retained job logs.

cwd.description:
Working directory. An absolute path defaults this to the project;
relative paths default to O_LANG_ROOT, matching o_execute.

env.description: Per-child environment overrides, isolated from other jobs and calls.

path.description:
Existing operation-project directory containing olang.project.toml with
an explicit [operation] section. Relative paths use cwd or O_LANG_ROOT.

run.description:
Retained run ID or last-run; accepted only by observe and replan.
Omission uses native last-run. Exact IDs avoid ambiguity between runs.

timeout_secs.description:
Foreground default 120 seconds; background default no deadline.
Zero disables the local deadline. Native execution limits still apply.

without_targets.description:
Exact declared target IDs to exclude. Required only for replan, which
computes an alternative without dispatching it.

tools.name: o_run
tools.description: Execute one complete .O source document or existing path through Ostadix's unified, project-aware front door and return its structured result

cwd.description: Optional working directory (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

mode.description: Operation mode: execute (default) or check (non-executing unified static plan and graph validation)

node_id.description: Optional discovered node identity for placement=node; omitted uses the remembered or deterministic node selection

path.description: Existing .O program or project path. Supply exactly one of path or source

placement.description: Execution placement: local (default unified front door), node (complete document on one selected hosted node), or project_mesh (project route on authenticated peers; never ordinary OIR graph splitting)

route.description: Optional project route ID when a project or lifted bundle has no unambiguous default

source.description: Complete .O source document. Supply exactly one of source or path

tools.name: o_runtimes
tools.description: Discover executable requirements for every canonical Ostadix backend without blocking on missing optional runtimes

tools.name: o_search_run
tools.description: Run a bundled O work program or an explicitly selected a18re search program with correct absolute backends

name.description: Leaf O program name, with optional .O suffix; bundled names resolve under examples/, external work names under search/

work.description: Optional a18re/work root; default A18_WORK, existing ~/a18re, or the bundled O_LANG_ROOT

tools.name: o_smoke
tools.description: Smoke-test O toolchain with a fixed Python-only computation (expect 2) and correct backends path
